question: What extraordinary power is manifested through muttering before an image?
premises: Muttering occurs in relation to an image.
This takes place in that context.
The breaking of pots and stones occurs.
inference: Muttering in that image-context can manifest the power to break pots and stones.
uncertainties: The token tasmi(n is written with a parenthesis in the source.
The exact ritual context of pratimā+jalpanan is unclear.
plain_english: In that muttering before an image, there is the breaking of pots and stones.
